title: 第23章 紫晓灵的拉拢第24章 服下丹药
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
在修炼室的修炼速度极快，半天时间下来，丘凌风的第六条主经脉就被打通了五分之二。
不过，对于没有修行功法的他来说，连续修炼半天已经就是极限了。
想要再次进入修炼室，只能等肉身恢复过来。
“只剩下三百多积分了，也该考虑一下接取任务了。”
丘凌风心中想道。
修炼室内的灵气渐渐淡去，这代表着丘凌风修炼时间已经到了。
此时此刻，已经是半夜十二点钟了。
“遭，又忘记时间了。”
丘凌风一敲脑袋，自言自语道。
离开了修行区，丘凌风就朝着宿舍赶去。
回到宿舍，赵柏几人还在聊着天。
早早洗了个澡之后，丘凌风就上床睡觉了。
第二天一早，丘凌风就被郝秀给叫醒了。
刷牙洗脸，然后一起去吃了顿早餐，就去报到了。
根据通讯手表上的信息，众人找到了自己的班级。
太玄剑院类比一下，管理模式大概就相当于前世的大学，但是没有各种院系。
跟赵柏几人一起来到班上后，丘凌风就看到了张小男的身影。
她也被分配到了这一个班级上。
跟张小男打了个招呼之后，丘凌风就开始等待了起来。
张小男走了过来，坐在了丘凌风的身边，道：

“你准不准备接几个任务？赚点积分？”
“当然要。”
丘凌风点了点头，道，
“你也要接任务么？”
“那当然，我昨天去外院弟子大厅那里了，我在任务区里看到了一个还不错的任务，在外面流民居住区那里杀几只小魔兽。”
张小男点头道，
“你去不去？一只三阶奴仆魔兽头颅就可以赚到一百积分。”
“这么多？”
丘凌风惊讶的道，
“要多少人？”
“上限是八个人。”
张小男说道，
“我这边加上舍友是四个人，你那也是一样的吧？”
“嗯，你舍友都是什么修为？”
丘凌风点了点头，问道。
“都是通脉境四段……”
张小男嘴巴一扁，嘟着嘴说道。
看来整个宿舍只有她这个通脉境二段，让她感觉到很委屈了。
“凌风，这位美女是？”
content_en:
The training speed in the training room was extremely fast. In half a day, two-fifths of Qiu Lingfeng's sixth main meridian was opened.
However, for him who has no practice skills, practicing for half a day is already the limit.
If you want to enter the training room again, you can only wait for your physical body to recover.
"There are only more than 300 points left, so it's time to consider taking on the mission."
Qiu Lingfeng thought in his heart.
The spiritual energy in the training room gradually faded away, which meant that Qiu Lingfeng's training time had come.
At this moment, it is already twelve o'clock in the middle of the night.
"Oh, I forgot the time again."
Qiu Lingfeng knocked his head and said to himself.
After leaving the practice area, Qiu Lingfeng rushed towards the dormitory.
Back in the dormitory, Zhao Bai and the others were still chatting.
After taking a bath early, Qiu Lingfeng went to bed.
Early the next morning, Qiu Lingfeng was woken up by Hao Xiu.
I brushed my teeth and washed my face, then went to have breakfast together before reporting in.
According to the information on the communication watch, everyone found their class.
By analogy, the management model of Taixuan Sword Academy is probably equivalent to that of a university in the previous life, but without various departments.
After arriving at the class with Zhao Bai and others, Qiu Lingfeng saw Zhang Xiaonan.
She was also assigned to this class.
After saying hello to Zhang Xiaonan, Qiu Lingfeng began to wait.
Zhang Xiaonan came over, sat next to Qiu Lingfeng, and said:
"Are you going to take on a few missions? Earn some points?"
"Of course."
Qiu Lingfeng nodded and said,
"Do you also want to take the mission?"
"Of course. I went to the disciple hall of the outer courtyard yesterday. I saw a pretty good mission in the mission area. Kill a few small monsters in the refugee residential area outside."
Zhang Xiaonan nodded and said,
"Are you going? You can earn 100 points with just one level 3 slave monster head."
"So many?"
Qiu Lingfeng said in surprise,
"How many people are needed?"
"The limit is eight people."
Zhang Xiaonan said,
"There are four of us here including my roommate. Is it the same for you?"
"Well, what are the cultivation levels of your roommates?"
Qiu Lingfeng nodded and asked.
"They are all in the fourth level of Tongmai Realm..."
Zhang Xiaonan flattened his mouth and said with a pout.
It seemed that she was the only one in the entire dormitory who was in the second level of Tongmai Realm, which made her feel very aggrieved.
"Ling Feng, who is this beauty?"
